steps.title: Sign of the Cross
steps.versicle: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.

steps.title: Novena Intention
steps.prompt: Offer your Christmas novena intention for day {{day}} of the nine days before the Nativity.

xmas_daily_prayer.text: Lord Jesus Christ, Infant King: as Thy holy Nativity draws near, prepare in me a place for Thee. Empty my heart of what crowds Thee out; kindle in me Thy own patient love; and let these nine days of waiting be an offering of my whole self, that on the feast of Thy birth I may receive Thee not as a stranger, but as my King. Amen.

hail_mary.text:
Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee.
Blessed art thou among women,
and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus.
Holy Mary, Mother of God,
pray for us sinners,
now and at the hour of our death.
Amen.
hail_mary.latin:
Ave Maria, gratia plena, Dominus tecum.
Benedicta tu in mulieribus,
et benedictus fructus ventris tui, Iesus.
Sancta Maria, Mater Dei,
ora pro nobis peccatoribus,
nunc et in hora mortis nostrae.
Amen.

glory_be.text:
Glory be to the Father,
and to the Son,
and to the Holy Spirit,
as it was in the beginning,
is now, and ever shall be,
world without end.
Amen.
glory_be.latin:
Gloria Patri, et Filio,
et Spiritui Sancto,
sicut erat in principio,
et nunc, et semper,
et in saecula saeculorum.
Amen.

schedule_note.note: The traditional Christmas novena: nine days before the Nativity, December 16 through 24 (Advent's 'Great O' antiphon days December 17-23 carry the per-day antiphon as the session's day variant). The fixed window is year-agnostic: every year's December 16..24 resolves, with Christmas Day completing the novena outside the due window.

variants.title: Day 1
variants.antiphon: Drop down dew, O ye heavens, from above, and let the clouds rain the just: let the earth be opened and bring forth a Saviour.
variants.source: Rorate caeli (Isaiah 45:8; the traditional rendering of the Advent introit)

variants.title: Day 2
variants.antiphon:
O Wisdom, coming forth from the mouth of the Most High,
reaching from one end to the other mightily,
and sweetly disposing all things:
Come and teach us the way of prudence.
variants.source: Traditional "Great O" Advent Antiphons (7th-8th century; rendering per the companion import o_antiphons)

variants.title: Day 3
variants.antiphon:
O Adonai, and leader of the House of Israel,
who appeared to Moses in the fire of the burning bush
and gave him the law on Sinai:
Come and redeem us with an outstretched arm.
variants.source: Traditional "Great O" Advent Antiphons (7th-8th century; rendering per the companion import o_antiphons)

variants.title: Day 4
variants.antiphon:
O Root of Jesse, standing as an ensign before the peoples,
before whom kings keep silence,
and unto whom the Gentiles shall make supplication:
Come to deliver us, and tarry not.
variants.source: Traditional "Great O" Advent Antiphons (7th-8th century; rendering per the companion import o_antiphons)

variants.title: Day 5
variants.antiphon:
O Key of David, and sceptre of the House of Israel,
who opens and no one shuts,
who shuts and no one opens:
Come and bring forth from prison the captive who sits in darkness and in the shadow of death.
variants.source: Traditional "Great O" Advent Antiphons (7th-8th century; rendering per the companion import o_antiphons)

variants.title: Day 6
variants.antiphon:
O Dayspring, brightness of light everlasting,
and Sun of righteousness:
Come and enlighten those who sit in darkness and in the shadow of death.
variants.source: Traditional "Great O" Advent Antiphons (7th-8th century; rendering per the companion import o_antiphons)

variants.title: Day 7
variants.antiphon:
O King of Nations, and their desired one,
the cornerstone that binds two into one:
Come and save mankind, whom you fashioned from clay.
variants.source: Traditional "Great O" Advent Antiphons (7th-8th century; rendering per the companion import o_antiphons)

variants.title: Day 8
variants.antiphon:
O Emmanuel, our King and Lawgiver,
the desire of the nations and their Savior:
Come and save us, O Lord our God.
variants.source: Traditional "Great O" Advent Antiphons (7th-8th century; rendering per the companion import o_antiphons)

variants.title: Day 9
variants.antiphon: For a child is born to us, and a son is given to us, and the government is upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, God the Mighty, the Father of the world to come, the Prince of Peace.
